Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6) • Install: Hospital

Advanced FIA spytech derived from old Zetatech research that allows agents to nigh-perfectly mimic another individual.

Iconic Internal Body Cyberware. Requires 1 Internal Body Option Slot. Replaces the user’s face with a nanotech synthskin faceplate that can change its facial structure, skin tone, texture, and intelligently adapt the user’s neural impulses to have their outward appearance reflect the mannerisms of a stored behavioral scan. Mechanically, this allows a user to automatically pass any Acting or other related Check to pretend to be the loaded personality. Behavioral scans are created by using this cyberware in tandem with paired Cybereyes or Smart Glasses to scan a target for a prolonged time (Minimum 5 minutes) while they are communicating and displaying various emotions.

The longer and more detailed the scan, the better this cyberware can replicate the individual. Upon installation of this cyberware, the user’s behavioral imprint is automatically added. If the user also has installed Audiovox, ChemSkin, Techhair, and paired Cybereyes, the behavioral imprint feature is also usable across the user’s entire body. This cannot change the physical size of the user. Premade Behavioral Imprints can be stored on Memory Chips and loaded with an Action, after which they remain stored on the faceplate. Changing between stored Behavioral Imprints requires an Action, and after doing so, the faceplate has a 30 minute cooldown.

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
